title: Local cell structure of the Thurston spine at a systole critical point
author: Ingrid Irmer
difficulty_reason: The proof must pass from a piecewise topological Morse normal form to a cell of the nonsmooth spine, relate balanced strata to the limiting eutactic gradient configurations, and force their systoles to fill. This geometric passage is the substantive core, not a direct use of smooth Morse theory on a manifold.
